properties.source: Los Angeles County Operational Area, Authoritative Cooling Center List (County Office of Emergency Management)
properties.source_revision: August 2026 list (map layer last edited August 26, 2026); checked November 11, 2026
properties.coordinates_source: Published by Los Angeles County with each site on its cooling center map layer; not geocoded by this project.
properties.activation: The county lists these sites with their regular days and hours. During extreme heat events some sites are designated Augmented Cooling Centers with extended hours, announced on the county page.
properties.notes: The county list covers the whole county, including City of Los Angeles library branches and recreation sites. Hours in each note are the regular hours the county list printed in August 2026, not live opening status. Per-site contact numbers on the county list are not reproduced here; call 2-1-1 or check the county page.
properties.geocoder: none: coordinates published by the source
